title: ASE Certification Practice Tests
content:
Shop Safety
Manufacturers use cable coloring, warning labels, and signs to warn technicians of possible hazards.
Cable Coloring
High voltage cables are typically colored orange, but may be blue or yellow. Working with hybrid and electric vehicles can be dangerous and best left to trained and certified professionals. Codes of practice, standards, and manufacturers guides are followed.
Warning labels
Manufacturers use standard warning labels and signs to warn technicians of possible danger.
PPE Personal Protective Equipment
EV technicians wear thick insulated gloves while working around high voltage components. Protective goggles, aprons, and dielectric boots protect technicians from hazards associated with high voltage cabling and components.
